hooks.name: catalog-validation
hooks.description: On save of data/catalog.json, run scripts/validate-catalog.ts via npm. Failures print to stderr with a CATALOG VALIDATION FAILED line and a non-zero exit so the agent and user see them (REQ-CD-24). A silent pass on an invalid catalog is a defect.

action.command: npm run validate-catalog 1>&2 || { echo 'CATALOG VALIDATION FAILED: data/catalog.json is invalid. Fix it before continuing; do not ignore this.' >&2; exit 1; }
